title: inheritance (TPH + TPC) × a concrete's `policy { read … }` gate × a concrete's `mask unless` field × the polymorphic base reads
note: The base read checks every concrete's list-read gate before it loads (403 for a caller who fails any) and masks each row through its concrete's own serializer.  The 403 half is the authz ladder (`AUTHZ_LADDERS`, test/behavioral/cases.mjs).

authzGate.//: The masked concretes' reads: the visitor reads them as the agent does, nulls and all.  The gated concretes and every base read are refused by the ladder; the masked writes are its `→ 403` mask-gate rungs.
